name: Pixel bitmap font
oneLiner: Every letter on a low-res canvas drawn from an original 1-bit bitmap font at whole pixels, so text is as crisp as the sprites at any scale; inline colour codes, word wrap, drop shadow or outline, and a typewriter that reveals dialogue letter by letter with pauses and blips.
notFor: games with non-Latin scripts (CJK, Arabic): the glyph set is printable ASCII plus a few symbols
high-resolution, smoothly scaled UIs where a vector font is wanted
long-form reading (documents, books): an 8 px font is for short game text

needs: the game's text draw calls (fillText or a bitmap-text helper) and width helpers
frame clock in ms from the game's fixed step (for the typewriter only)
optional: the places where a message, caption or dialogue line is set, and the confirm key that advances it
provides: text widths and wrapped lines for layout
typewriter progress (done, characters shown) and a blip callback for sound
list of drawn text boxes (for tests and other overlays)

assets: module/pixel-font.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_PixelFont): original 'regular' 6x8 proportional and 'small' 5x7 bitmap fonts (full printable ASCII plus ... arrows, heart, middle dot), layout, wrap, colour codes, shadows, typewriter, drawing
no image, font or audio files
